body:
## Summary

When the `@rev` of a git dependency is the 40-hex id of an **annotated tag object** (what `git rev-parse vX` returns for an annotated tag), uv treats it as an exact commit, fetches it, and then fails because the commit it ends up on is the tag's peeled commit. The error names the right commit but not why the two ids differ, so the pin reads as corrupt rather than as "you pinned the tag object".

## Reproduction

Any public repo with an annotated tag works; `psf/requests` here.

```
$ git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/psf/requests.git 'refs/tags/v2.32.3*'
61e2240f283f15780ac2d0e2cfefb0fd6fdab627	refs/tags/v2.32.3
0e322af87745eff34caffe4df68456ebc20d9068	refs/tags/v2.32.3^{}

$ uvx --no-cache --from "git+https://github.com/psf/requests@61e2240f283f15780ac2d0e2cfefb0fd6fdab627" python -c 'import requests; print(requests.__version__)'
   Updating https://github.com/psf/requests (61e2240f283f15780ac2d0e2cfefb0fd6fdab627)
error: Failed to resolve `--with` requirement
  cause: Git operation failed
  cause: Exact Git revision `61e2240f283f15780ac2d0e2cfefb0fd6fdab627` does not match precise commit `0e322af87745eff34caffe4df68456ebc20d9068` for `https://github.com/psf/requests`

$ uvx --no-cache --from "git+https://github.com/psf/requests@0e322af87745eff34caffe4df68456ebc20d9068" python -c 'import requests; print(requests.__version__)'
2.32.3
```

The peeled commit (`v2.32.3^{commit}`) installs; the tag object id does not.

## Ask

One of:

- peel an annotated-tag object to its commit (the fetch already has the tag object, so the target commit is known), or
- make the error say that the given rev is an annotated-tag object and suggest pinning `vX^{commit}` (or the peeled id shown), and
- a line in the git-dependencies docs that a full-sha pin must be a commit id, and that `git rev-parse <tag>` of an annotated tag is not one.

## Platform

uv 0.13.6 (Homebrew build of 2026-10-26, aarch64-apple-darwin), macOS 26 (Darwin 27.0.0).
title: Annotated-tag object id given as a git rev fails with "Exact Git revision does not match precise commit"
